findings.cause: W08 horizontal legend frame (24,763.4,392,51.3), final Max label (334,763.4,78,51.3). The label is visually fully visible and horizontally inside the legend. A dy=2 inset makes any equal-height label impossible to contain vertically.
findings.proposed_fix: Use legend frame ∩ window insetBy(dx:2,dy:0), retaining horizontal full-frame containment. This is a test geometry correction; keep MAX pan and end capture.

findings.cause: Generic numeric clear-and-type changed seeded first-set weight from 60 to 6 and returned false before the changed W07/W08/W09 surfaces. Reps remained 10. Seeder inserts bench-press default weight 60; actual previous and remaining set rows show 60×10.
findings.proposed_fix: In this B11 audit only, assert exact first-set weight 60 and reps 10, then complete that valid seeded set. Numeric replacement is unchanged behavior outside this target gate; this preserves first-set completion and all W07/W08/W09 checks.

findings.cause: W07 after +30 capture has Skip behind floating TabBar. AX: scroll frame y0..956; TabBar y873..956; Skip y844.5..921.8, while vertical scrollbar is at 97% and leaves scroll room. Countdown 1:13 before +30 and 1:40 after proves addTime acted.
findings.proposed_fix: Before both W07 captures, require +30s and Skip full frames in a viewport clipped at visible TabBar minY−4; bounded scroll upward. Then tap +30s, capture, and Skip immediately. Do not use scroll.frame ∩ window inset(4,4) alone: that extends to y952 and falsely accepts obscured Skip.
